nodes.description: string public name; set to 'EasterEgg' in the constructor
string public symbol; set to 'EGG' in the constructor
uint8 public decimals; set to 9 in the constructor
uint256 public _totalSupply; total token supply minted to the deployer
mapping(address => uint) balances; token balance ledger mutated by transfer/transferFrom and the constructor
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; allowance ledger mutated by approve/transferFrom
constructor(); initialises name/symbol/decimals/_totalSupply and credits msg.sender with the whole supply
totalSupply(); returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner); read-only getter over balances
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender); read-only getter over allowed
approve(address spender, uint tokens); writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval
transfer(address to, uint tokens); debits/credits balances via SafeMath and emits Transfer
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens); moves balances and decrements allowance via SafeMath, emits Transfer
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b); returns a + b with require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b); requires b <= a then returns a - b
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b); returns a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b); requires b > 0 then returns a / b
msg.sender used by the constructor as the initial token holder
msg.sender used by approve() as the owner key of the allowance write
msg.sender used by transfer() as the source balance key
msg.sender used by transferFrom() as the spender key of allowed[from][msg.sender]
transfer(): balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) - state write indexed by caller
transfer(): balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) - state write to a caller-supplied address
approve(): allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens - arbitrary allowance overwrite, no zero-first check
transferFrom(): balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) - no explicit allowance verification before debit
transferFrom(): allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) - decrement of caller-keyed allowance
transferFrom(): balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) - state write to a caller-supplied address
constructor(): balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply - whole supply minted to the deployer
totalSupply(): _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed without SafeMath -> arithmetic underflow risk

address tokenOwner of allowance()

address spender of approve()

address to of transferFrom()

uint b of safeDiv()

named return value uint remaining of allowance()
named return value bool success of approve()

named return value bool success of transferFrom()
named return value uint c of safeAdd(); c = a + b
named return value uint c of safeSub(); c = a - b
named return value uint c of safeMul(); c = a * b
named return value uint c of safeDiv(); c = a / b

edges.reason: transfer() calls SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance
transfer() calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance
transferFrom() calls SafeMath.safeSub twice (from-balance and allowance)
transferFrom() calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance
constructor executes the initial mint write to balances
totalSupply() executes the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
approve() executes the allowance mapping write
transfer() path reaches the sender debit write
transfer() path reaches the recipient credit write
transferFrom() path reaches the from-balance debit write
transferFrom() path reaches the allowance decrement write
transferFrom() path reaches the recipient credit write
msg.sender is read by the constructor to select the initial holder
msg.sender enters approve() as the implicit owner key
msg.sender enters transfer() as the implicit source account
msg.sender enters transferFrom() as the implicit spender account
msg.sender is used as the balances index of the constructor mint
msg.sender is the first-level index of the approve() allowance write
msg.sender indexes balances in the transfer() debit write
msg.sender is the spender key of allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom(); authorization derives only from caller identity
balances is read and written by the transfer() debit
balances is read and written by the transfer() credit
allowed is written by approve()
balances is read and written by the transferFrom() debit of 'from'
allowed is read and written by the transferFrom() allowance decrement
balances is read and written by the transferFrom() credit of 'to'
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend of the unchecked totalSupply() subtraction
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply()
_totalSupply is assigned by the constructor
_totalSupply is returned (minus balances[address(0)]) by totalSupply()
balances is read by balanceOf()
allowed is read by allowance()
tokenOwner parameter selects the balances slot read by balanceOf()
tokenOwner parameter selects the first key read by allowance()
spender parameter selects the second key read by allowance()
spender parameter is forwarded to approve()
tokens parameter is forwarded to approve()
to parameter is forwarded to transfer()
tokens parameter is forwarded to transfer()
from parameter is forwarded to transferFrom()
to parameter is forwarded to transferFrom()
tokens parameter is forwarded to transferFrom()
a is the left operand of c = a + b in safeAdd()
b is the right operand of c = a + b in safeAdd()
a is the left operand of c = a - b in safeSub()
b is the right operand of c = a - b in safeSub()
a is the left operand of c = a * b in safeMul()
b is the right operand of c = a * b in safeMul()
a is the dividend of c = a / b in safeDiv()
b is the divisor of c = a / b in safeDiv()
spender parameter indexes the approve() allowance write
tokens parameter is the value written by approve()
from parameter indexes the transferFrom() debit write
tokens parameter is the amount subtracted from balances[from] in transferFrom()
tokens parameter is the amount subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom()
to parameter indexes the transferFrom() credit write
tokens parameter is the amount added to balances[to] in transferFrom()
to parameter indexes the transfer() credit write
tokens parameter is the amount subtracted in the transfer() debit
tokens parameter is the amount added in the transfer() credit
balances[tokenOwner] flows into the named return value balance
allowed[tokenOwner][spender] flows into the named return value remaining
approve() returns the literal true into the named return value success
transfer() returns the literal true into the named return value success
transferFrom() returns the literal true into the named return value success
safeAdd() assigns a + b to c, guarded by require(c >= a)
safeSub() assigns a - b to c, guarded by require(b <= a)
safeMul() assigns a * b to c, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
safeDiv() assigns a / b to c, guarded by require(b > 0)

Approval event is emitted immediately after the allowance write; event emission is the only outbound interaction and no external call precedes it, so no exploitable reentrancy but the emit-post-write ordering is recorded
Transfer event is emitted after both balance writes in transfer(); no external call exists between state change and emit, so reentrancy is only a theoretical ordering concern
Transfer event is emitted after the balance and allowance writes in transferFrom(); no external call, reentrancy not exploitable here
